analyst.summary: GRSE has executed its defence shipbuilding order book exceptionally well, with revenue and profit both growing sharply this year on strong warship deliveries. However, the order book itself has shrunk to a five-year low, and the next major program is not expected to add revenue for another year and a half, so the pace of growth investors have seen recently is unlikely to continue unchanged without fresh order wins. We rate this a Hold: an excellent operator, but the growth runway needs replenishing.
